channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Ersan Ilyasova | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Ersan Ilyasova from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Ersan Ilyasova
item.description:
Eric Walden:Quin Snyder on Ersan Ilyasova's early outburst:

“That’s one of the things he’s capable of doing. His aggressiveness tonight is something we want.”

Quin Snyder on Ersan Ilyasova, Apr 17, 2021. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Dennis Lindsey, Justin Zanik, Ersan Ilyasova, Bojan Bogdanovic, Georges Niang
item.description:
Ben Anderson:Quin Snyder on finding a player in Ersan Ilyasova who brings similar traits to Bogdanovic and Niang:

“Dennis and Justin and our group wouldn't have looked at someone you couldn't plug and play. I think the one thing we've been really conscious of is the chemistry of the team.”

Quin Snyder on Dennis Lindsey, Justin Zanik, Ersan Ilyasova, Bojan Bogdanovic, Georges Niang, Mar 11, 2021. Source: Twitter @BensHoops.

item.title: Bryan Colangelo on Ersan Ilyasova
item.description:
“I want to thank Ersan Ilyasova for his positive contributions to this organization both on and off the basketball court,”

Bryan Colangelo on Ersan Ilyasova, Feb 22, 2017. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Rob Hennigan on Serge Ibaka, Ersan Ilyasova, Victor Oladipo
item.description:
“Serge (Ibaka) is a young veteran who brings tremendous athleticism and toughness to our frontcourt. His tireless work ethic and wealth of playoff experience will help enhance our culture and roster. We thank Victor (Oladipo) for all of his contributions both on the court and in the community. We wish him and Ersan (Ilyasova) the best of luck in the future,”

Rob Hennigan on Serge Ibaka, Ersan Ilyasova, Victor Oladipo, Jun 24, 2016. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Sam Presti on Ersan Ilyasova
item.description:
Fred Katz:Presti on Ilyasova:

“We traded for him because we think he's a good complementary player with our core players.”

Sam Presti on Ersan Ilyasova, Jun 24, 2016. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Rob Hennigan on Brandon Jennings, Ersan Ilyasova
item.description:
The Orlando Magic have acquired guard Brandon Jennings and forward Ersan Ilyasova from the Detroit Pistons in exchange for forward Tobias Harris, General Manager Rob Hennigan announced today.

“Brandon (Jennings) and Ersan (Ilyasova) are two veterans that will help balance our roster and provide valuable experience to our team,”

Rob Hennigan on Brandon Jennings, Ersan Ilyasova, Feb 16, 2016. Source: NBA.com.
